verdict.rationale: VLP's IP practice page documents trademark filing/prosecution (including Madrid Protocol international applications) and IP due diligence, but trademark work is bundled together with patents and copyright under a single 'Intellectual Property' practice rather than a distinct trademark/brand enforcement team, and there is no explicit mention of clearance searches or brand enforcement/litigation. Missing for 10: dedicated trademark/brand enforcement sub-practice description, clearance search services, and enforcement (infringement/litigation) capability evidence.
